note: Computed from TLSNotary benchmark anchors (May 2026). MPC model: 240/BW + 1.56 s (30 MB garbled-circuit upload = 240 Mb). Proxy model: 15/BW + 1.0 s (lighter pre-session traffic). Both models reproduce published anchor points within 5%.

mpc.note: Derived: speedup 1.8× × Proxy 1 s at 1 Gbps

speedup.note: Speedup = MPC time / Proxy time. Falls monotonically from 12.5× to 1.8× as bandwidth rises.
